content:
./configure
make -j$(nproc) all
FUZZERS="cmsIT8_load_fuzzer cms_transform_fuzzer cms_overwrite_transform_fuzzer"
for F in $FUZZERS; do
    $CC $CFLAGS -c -Iinclude         $SRC/$F.c -o $SRC/$F.o
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS         $SRC/$F.o -o $OUT/$F         $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE src/.libs/liblcms2.a
done
cp $SRC/icc.dict $SRC/*.options $OUT/

#include <stdint.h>

#include "lcms2.h"

// The main sink
int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size) {
  if (size == 0)
    return 0;

  cmsHANDLE handle = cmsIT8LoadFromMem(0, (void *)data, size);
  if (handle)
    cmsIT8Free(handle);

  return 0;
}
